Header.Main Text: Your peaceful stay beneath the Three Crowns

About.Slogan: Discover peace in the heart of Pieniny National Park
About.Description: Relax where the Dunajec River meets the silence of the Pieniny Mountains. Located in the heart of Pieniny National Park in the village of Červený Kláštor, our year-round guesthouse offers cozy cottages and apartments surrounded by beautiful nature. Enjoy peaceful mornings with optional breakfast, pleasant evenings with family and friends by the fireplace or barbecue, and relaxing moments in the garden seating area within the guesthouse grounds. Private parking, fully equipped kitchenettes, and a children’s play corner are available for your comfort. Whether you are planning a family holiday, a trip with friends, a school excursion, or a small corporate gathering, you will find comfort, tranquility, and space to enjoy time together in the unique atmosphere of the Pieniny region. A place to slow down, breathe deeply, and return again.

Accommodation.Slogan: Comfortable and fully equipped rooms for your pleasant and relaxing stay

Penzion1.Title: Guesthouse Under the Three Crowns
Penzion1.Desc1: The guesthouse offers comfortable accommodation in six separate rooms, making it ideal for families with children, groups of friends, and smaller organized stays. Four rooms are located on the first floor, two of which include private bathrooms with a shower, sink, and toilet, while the remaining two share bathroom facilities. The other two rooms are situated in a cozy attic on the second floor and have access to an additional shared bathroom.
Penzion1.Desc2: Guests can enjoy a spacious common room with a fireplace, a TV with satellite channels, and comfortable seating, creating a pleasant place to relax after a day spent exploring the surrounding nature. A children’s play corner is also available for younger guests. The property also includes a dining area and a fully equipped kitchen with a gas stove, electric oven, microwave, fridge with freezer, and electric kettle, suitable for preparing your own meals.
Penzion1.Desc3: Right next to the guesthouse, there is an outdoor seating area with a fireplace. Free WiFi is available throughout the entire property, ensuring a comfortable stay even during longer visits.
Pricing: Children under 3 stay free. Baby cot: €10 / stay.

Penzion2.Title: Cottage Under the Three Crowns
Penzion2.Desc1: The Cottage Under the Three Crowns offers comfortable accommodation in four separate rooms and is an ideal choice for families with children or smaller groups looking for a quieter stay with greater privacy. Located in the rear part of the courtyard, the cottage provides a peaceful atmosphere perfect for relaxing throughout your stay. The property includes two bathrooms with a shower, sink, and toilet.
Penzion2.Desc2: Guests can enjoy a cozy common room with a fireplace, a TV with satellite channels, and comfortable seating, creating a welcoming space to relax after a day spent exploring the surrounding nature. A fully equipped kitchen with a large dining table is also available for preparing and enjoying meals together.
Penzion2.Desc3: Right next to the cottage, there is an outdoor seating area with a fireplace, while behind the cottage guests can make use of a grill area with additional seating. The property also includes a spacious meadow and a children’s playground, making it especially suitable for families. Free WiFi is available throughout the entire cottage.
Pricing: Children under 3 stay free. Baby cot: €10 / stay.

Apartment1.Title: Garden View Apartment
Apartment1.Desc1: The Garden View Apartment offers comfortable and peaceful accommodation, ideal especially for couples or small families looking for greater privacy during their stay. The apartment features a separate room with a double bed and the possibility of two extra beds, providing enough space for a family as well.
Apartment1.Desc2: A cozy atmosphere is created by the fireplace stove, making the apartment especially pleasant during colder days. The apartment is equipped with a TV with satellite channels, a private bathroom with a shower, and a fully equipped kitchenette including a gas stove with electric oven, microwave, fridge with freezer, electric kettle, and dining table.
Apartment1.Desc3: Free WiFi is available throughout the apartment to ensure a comfortable stay even during longer visits. Thanks to its garden-facing location, the apartment provides a quiet and relaxing environment in the beautiful surroundings of the Pieniny region.

Apartment2.Title: Mountain View Apartment
Apartment2.Desc1: The apartment with a view of the Three Crowns offers comfortable and peaceful accommodation, ideal especially for couples or small families looking for privacy and relaxation during their stay. It is located in the rear part of the property in the same building as the cottage and features a separate entrance, ensuring a quiet and undisturbed stay.
Apartment2.Desc2: The apartment includes a separate room with a double bed and the possibility of two extra beds. It is equipped with a TV with satellite channels, a private bathroom with a shower, and a fully equipped kitchen suitable for preparing your own meals.
Apartment2.Desc3: Free WiFi is available throughout the apartment. Thanks to its peaceful location and beautiful view of the mountains, the apartment provides an ideal place to relax in the natural surroundings of the Pieniny National Park.
